listen.title: Listen address
listen.description: Address and port that accept browser telemetry. The default accepts connections from this host only.

public_url.title: Public URL
public_url.description: Public receiver base URL used to generate installation snippets. If neither receiver nor site sets a public URL, no snippet is offered.

tls_cert.title: TLS certificate
tls_cert.description: Server certificate file. Leave empty with TLS key to serve HTTP.

tls_key.title: TLS key
tls_key.description: Server private key file. Set together with TLS certificate to serve HTTPS.

trusted_proxies.title: Trusted proxies
trusted_proxies.description: Proxy IP addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to supply forwarded client addresses. Leave empty to distrust forwarded headers.

geoip_db.title: GeoIP database
geoip_db.description: MaxMind city database file. Leave empty to use the Agent IP intelligence database; unavailable data produces unknown locations.

max_body_bytes.title: Maximum payload size
max_body_bytes.description: Maximum accepted browser payload size, in bytes. Larger requests are rejected.

per_ip_per_min.title: Requests per IP
per_ip_per_min.description: Maximum requests per client IP per minute.

per_site_per_sec.title: Requests per site
per_site_per_sec.description: Maximum requests per site per second.
